result.title: Typographic Attack Against VLM-based AI-generated Image Detection
result.summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used for AI-generated image (AIGI) detection, providing natural-language explanations for authenticity judgments. However, their ability to interpret text within images may also expose these judgments to misleading semantic cues. We systematically evaluate typographic attack strategies across detection-oriented, open-weight, and commercial VLMs, considering both real-to-fake and fake-to-real attacks. Our results show that reasoning modes generally exhibit greater vulnerability than direct modes and that attack effectiveness exhibits pronounced directional asymmetry. Moreover, larger models tend to exhibit higher clean detection accuracy but also higher attack success rates. We further examine attack robustness under image and text transformations and investigate whether overlays indicating the correct class can aid error correction. Together, these analyses characterize how typographic attacks influence authenticity judgments and expose limitations of current VLM-based AIGI detection systems.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文系统评测排版攻击（在图上叠加误导性文字）对基于 VLM 的 AI 生成图像检测的影响，覆盖开源与商用模型、双向攻击方向、图像与文本变换下的鲁棒性，以及叠加正确类别提示能否纠错。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接涉及多模态推理中「推理模式比直接模式更易被文本语义线索误导」这一现象，与 LVR 关心的推理状态是否真正使用视觉证据、还是被语言旁路接管高度相关，其方向不对称与模型规模趋势可供核查。
